# LatticeOS

> LatticeOS is a repository-native UI control plane for coding agents. Phase 1 Reuse is active. It
> finds and explains existing UI before an agent creates more. Later Understand, Doctor, Converge,
> and repair work is blocked until Reuse passes its acceptance and benchmark gates.

Repository: https://github.com/Karthick-Ramachandran/LatticeOS
Product name: LatticeOS
Public CLI name: lattice
Status: pre-release; the package gate proves both a seven-tarball workspace fixture and one bundled
offline-installed CLI artifact. Nine `reuse-v1` candidate pairs record a historical 15 vs 14 score,
but lack raw delivery evidence and fail the current checker. Nothing is published.

Durable repository memory under docs/ is authoritative over chat history. Never edit an accepted ADR.
Use the Persist CLI for new feature memory and decisions as AGENTS.md requires.

## Current implementation

- apps/docs: Fumadocs site, search, copyable code, /llms.txt, /llms-full.txt, and per-page Markdown.
- packages/core: schema version 1, stable component IDs, validation, deterministic JSON, lexical
  evidence-backed ranking, ambiguity, and bounded context.
- packages/analyzer: confined repository reads, exclusions, bounds, workspace packages, static tool
  detection, React/Tailwind/shadcn/Storybook bridge orchestration, deterministic Reuse index assembly,
  generated cache lifecycle, and the fixed initialization-config writer are implemented.
- packages/adapters: React component analysis, static Tailwind token/class evidence, static shadcn
  configured-source evidence, and bounded local Storybook manifest evidence are implemented.
- packages/cli: source-tested `init`, `search`, `inspect`, and `context` commands are implemented.
  The package gate proves the legacy controlled Next.js fixture and one bundled tarball installed
  offline in a minimal external TypeScript/JSX fixture. It is not published, and the Reuse benchmark
  is still required.
- benchmarks/reuse-v1: pre-registered source-only tasks, local result validation, synthetic
  verifier tests, and nine recorded candidate agent-trial pairs. They have a historical 15 versus 14
  score, but `pnpm benchmark:check` now rejects them because raw delivery artifacts are missing. The
  result is local to the controlled fixture and declared agent.
- ADR-0021 keeps any harder fixture separate from frozen `reuse-v1`. Do not create it until a new
  benchmark feature has its own PRD, acceptance, fixture, task protocol, and security review.

Do not describe workspace CLI examples as published behavior. The one-artifact package proof passes,
the package is pre-release, AC-16 passed on 2026-09-01, and Phase 1 still needs qualified AC-15
delivery evidence. The archived 15 versus 14 score is one `SecondaryButton` annotation on a tidy
fixture where control already reused canonical UI in 8 of 9 pairs. Do not start Figma or Phase 2
from it.

## Hard boundaries

- No Figma, browser comparison, Converge, semantic rules, or autonomous repair in Phase 1.
- Never execute an analyzed repository's source or configuration.
- Never read secret paths or write application source.
- Phase 1 runtime has no telemetry, network, cloud, MCP, or AI API behavior.
- Every recommendation reason references evidence that inspect can resolve.
- A score ranks repository evidence. It does not prove product meaning or semantic equivalence.
- Support claims require fixtures and tests.

## Required checks

pnpm test:run
pnpm typecheck
pnpm build
pnpm test:package
pnpm docs:check
persist doctor

Run pnpm build and pnpm docs:check sequentially because both build the same Next.js docs app.
